dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a concave curvature that transitions from a horizontal posterior ridge into a forward-leaning vertical ascent towards the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius at the maximum morphological height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin displays a multi-stage slope: a shallow initial angle relative to the dorsal axis followed by a steepening incline of approximately 65 degrees as it approaches the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High width-to-height ratio (approximately 2.5:1) due to the extended horizontal length of the posterior insertion point.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregularly shaped white depigmentation patch on the mid-leading edge; multiple small, circular white punctate marks distributed across the lateral surface of the fin and dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Elongated posterior dorsal ridge that tapers gradually into the body axis, extending significantly further than the anterior insertion.
